lines.say: [excited] First day, Sarge! How long does a Guardsman usually last?
lines.text: FIRST DAY, SARGE! HOW LONG DOES A GUARDSMAN USUALLY LAST?

lines.say: [nervous] ...And how long have I been here?
lines.text: ...AND HOW LONG HAVE I BEEN HERE?

lines.say: [proudly] One Ork slain. The Emperor is pleased.
lines.text: ONE ORK SLAIN. THE EMPEROR IS PLEASED.

lines.say: [deadpan] Congrats, kid. You've got one hour left.
lines.text: CONGRATS, KID. YOU'VE GOT ONE HOUR LEFT.
